response.final_analysis: Selenium deficiency is well-documented to cause Keshan disease, a specific type of cardiomyopathy. This is supported by the role of selenium in antioxidant defense, crucial for protecting heart muscle cells from oxidative damage. Other options, while potentially contributing to heart health issues, do not have as direct or well-documented links to cardiomyopathy as selenium.
